answer: The fee is charged through a knoll debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the ivory totals, and the quill anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 15 units per epoch, sustaining 153 aliases for 18 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the adversary. Each active identity forfeits a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 40 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
